data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: DSO_SPRINT_MODE eliminated from check-sprint-trailer.sh (GREEN phase)
- DD3: 4-cell trailer matrix implemented (GREEN phase)

## Implementation
Rewrite `plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh` to implement the four-cell matrix:

1. Resolve CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (BASH_SOURCE fallback pattern from skip-review-check.sh)
2. Read `dso.workflow` via `bash "${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/read-config.sh" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null`
3. Check for `.sprint-active` marker at `$REPO_ROOT/.sprint-active`
4. Only enforce trailer when BOTH conditions hold: `dso.workflow=ci-pr` AND `.sprint-active` exists

New logic:
```bash
_SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
_PLUGIN_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$(cd "$_SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)}"
REPO_ROOT="${PROJECT_ROOT:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}"

_workflow=$(bash "${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/read-config.sh" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null || echo "local")
_sprint_marker="$REPO_ROOT/.sprint-active"

# Only enforce in ci-pr mode with active sprint marker (cells 2, 3, 4 = no-op)
if [[ "$_workflow" != "ci-pr" || ! -f "$_sprint_marker" ]]; then
    exit 0
fi

# Cell 1: ci-pr + sprint-active → enforce trailer
_commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format=%B 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if ! echo "$_commit_msg" | git interpret-trailers --parse 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^DSO-Story:'; then
    echo "ERROR: ..." >&2
    exit 1
fi
exit 0
```

Remove: `DSO_SPRINT_MODE` env var check entirely.
Preserve: git log / interpret-trailers logic for cell 1 enforcement.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-check-sprint-trailer.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] check-sprint-trailer.sh no longer references DSO_SPRINT_MODE
  Verify: ! grep -q 'DSO_SPRINT_MODE' plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh
- [ ] check-sprint-trailer.sh reads dso.workflow via read-config.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'read-config.sh.*dso\.workflow\|dso\.workflow' plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh
- [ ] check-sprint-trailer.sh checks for .sprint-active marker
  Verify: grep -q '\.sprint-active' plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh
- [ ] Cell 1 behavior: ci-pr + sprint-active + no-trailer → exit non-zero
  Verify: _T=$(mktemp -d) && touch "$_T/.sprint-active" && _C=$(mktemp) && echo 'dso.workflow=ci-pr' > "$_C" && git -C "$_T" init -q && git -C "$_T" config user.email t@t.com && git -C "$_T" config user.name T && echo x > "$_T/f" && git -C "$_T" add f && git -C "$_T" commit -qm "no trailer" && rc=0 && (cd "$_T" && WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$_C" PROJECT_ROOT="$_T" bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh" 2>/dev/null) || rc=$?; rm -rf "$_T" "$_C"; test "$rc" -ne 0
- [ ] Cell 2 behavior: ci-pr + no sprint-active → exit 0
  Verify: _T=$(mktemp -d) && _C=$(mktemp) && echo 'dso.workflow=ci-pr' > "$_C" && git -C "$_T" init -q && git -C "$_T" config user.email t@t.com && git -C "$_T" config user.name T && echo x > "$_T/f" && git -C "$_T" add f && git -C "$_T" commit -qm "no trailer" && WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$_C" PROJECT_ROOT="$_T" bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh" 2>/dev/null; rc=$?; rm -rf "$_T" "$_C"; test "$rc" -eq 0

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Implement check-sprint-trailer.sh: replace DSO_SPRINT_MODE with dso.workflow=ci-pr + .sprint-active matrix
